name: Bridge probe — well-covered films across distinct territories
note: Not a real programme. Fourteen films chosen so that MovieLens has thousands of raters for each, and so that the set spans clearly separate territories: Coen crime, American arthouse, cerebral science fiction and mannered comedy. If Slate finds bridges here, their audience claim can be tested against real viewing. The sci-fi season covers well but produces no bridges, and the three festivals produce bridges that MovieLens has never heard of.

films.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
